_meta.description: D6 fixtures for ms-agent-python / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI (recovery_agent.py, injectA2UITool=false). MAF has no toolkit validate→retry loop (unlike LangGraph get_a2ui_tools); the agent uses the a2ui_dynamic secondary-LLM pattern (forced _design_a2ui_surface). NO `context` match field: a real browser (the dojo) does NOT send x-aimock-context (only the test harness does), so context-scoped fixtures would 404 in-browser. The recovery pills' prompts are UNIQUE (same as LG suggestions.ts), so userMessage alone disambiguates. Flow per pill: outer generate_a2ui emit (hasToolResult:false + userMessage; context arg steers the secondary call when session does not surface the pill text); inner _design_a2ui_surface (userMessage=steering phrase + toolName); outer narration (hasToolResult:true). HEAL: secondary returns valid Column + two Metric tiles -> paints declarative-metric x2. EXHAUST: secondary returns structurally invalid surface (dangling child) -> parity target is a graceful failure / no broken paint. toolCallId prefixes use call_d6_msap_ for uniqueness vs LG's call_d6_lp_.
